candidate_windows.window_text: Our work complies with the ACL Ethics Policy, and we believe that testing how well language models handle languages other than English is an important avenue of research to reduce the potential harms of language model applications. We did not train any models for this study; instead, we used the pre-trained XGLM (Lin et al., 2022) and PolyLM (Wei et al., 2023) families of models made available through the transformers Python package (Wolf et al., 2020). All analyses were run on an NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU, running for a total of 4 hours.
